# Templates

Fill-in documents that an organization adapts for its own use: a privacy policy, a privacy impact assessment, a record of processing, an incident notice. They are planned (see the roadmap) and will be added here, in French and English.

Everything in this folder is licensed [CC BY 4.0](../../LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt): copy and adapt it with credit, and keep your adapted copy private if you wish. These templates help an organization meet its obligations. They are not legal advice.
